title: El Porfiriato
goal: Read how Porfirio Díaz's 34-year rule combined real economic modernization with extreme land concentration and repression, and why the order failed to hold in 1910.
grammar: Llevar + gerundio: cuánto tiempo llevaba ocurriendo algo

items: State how long Díaz had been governing Mexico by 1910.
Explain what the Porfiriato had been concentrating at an extraordinary rate.
Describe how the regime combined modernization with repression by the army and rural police.
Explain why the Porfirian order proved unable to contain democratic and peasant pressure.
Use llevar + gerund to express how long something had already been happening.
